about.heading: About Me
about.content:
A dedicated and technically skilled higher education professional with over 3 years of experience as a Teaching Assistant at Hong Kong Baptist University's School of Business. I possess extensive hands-on experience in supporting data-intensive postgraduate programs, managing course delivery, and facilitating student learning in a dynamic academic environment.

My expertise centers on providing comprehensive academic and technical support:

Instructional & Technical Support: Assisted in the delivery and tutorial sessions for multiple MSc-level courses, including Big Data Analytics with Python, Artificial Intelligence in Business, Cloud Computing for Business Analytics, and Econometrics. Skilled in explaining complex data concepts and guiding students through practical implementations.

Data Skills Application: Proficient in using Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn), R, and SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) for data analysis, automation, and database management tasks directly applied in an academic setting.

Systems & Communication Proficiency: Fully familiar with the Moodle learning management system (LMS) and standard university administrative protocols, including formal email communication and academic coordination.

I am now seeking a role within a university setting—such as Teaching Assistant, Postgraduate Program Administrator, or Global Exchange Office Support—where I can leverage my operational experience, technical competencies, and understanding of academic processes to contribute effectively to program delivery and student success.
